title_en: The map — seven movements, one project, one contract
how_to_read: sentences[].w = first..last word id inside this chapter; word k (0-based) of the sentence is first+k and `ar` is the spoken text (its space-separated tokens are those words); fr = [start_frame, end_frame] at 24 fps from the word map; impact = hook words (id=text); num = spoken numbers with data-contract fact ids; first_mention = glossary terms to chip (id=term); dup = same claim in another chapter. Anchor with {word, lead_frames} only. Visual candidates are ideas, never footage.

constraints.anchors: {word, lead_frames} only; never seconds or frames; event frame = word start - lead_frames
constraints.lead_frames: kinetic word -3, graphic state change -2, shot cut -4..-6 (inside a pause >= 200 ms), counter starts at the number word
constraints.density: >= 20 events/min; no gap > 4 s without an event (hold <= 6 s with reason); shot median 6-12 s, max 25 s (shots > 12 s: an event every 3 s)
constraints.coverage: every sentence >= 1 anchored event; >= 80 % of sentences a mechanism event; every spoken number and every first-mention term on screen
constraints.kinetic: 8-20 kinetic words per minute; <= 6 words and <= 2 lines on screen; impact word 1-2 words
constraints.fx: hero (real-time 3D) <= 5 % of chapter frames (ADR-002 RT5); fx_tier lite|standard|hero
constraints.text: text on busy backgrounds needs a plate or halo; sizes and safe areas: 04 sections 3.2 and 3.4
banned: invented numbers (every number: data-contract id or source sentence)
constraints.components: use only frozen components (harness/schemas/components/); requests go to corpus/specs/_component_requests.jsonl
constraints.chapter_rhythm: problem -> mental model -> progressive visual -> worked example -> prediction -> failure (crit) -> fix (ok) -> callback -> artifact (per chapter, not per sentence)

storyboard_notes.text: Front-loaded orientation stack (DD-P00-1, DD-P00-2 before CH-03; about 8 min shorter without DD-P01): give it a visual roadmap spine, an A-01 zoom-out and progress cues so it reads as an overview, not a delay. Director and educator lenses review it.

sentences.ar: سبع مراحل. من الصفر لجهاز تعرف تشتغل عليه files وfolders وterminal وأول سطر code.
sentences.en: Seven movements: from nothing to a working machine — files, folders, the terminal, your first line of code.

sentences.ar: من الكود للداتا المنظمة variables وtables وSQL وkeys وtransactions.
sentences.en: From code to structured data — variables, tables, SQL, keys, transactions.

sentences.ar: من برنامج صغير لنظام software حقيقي objects وtests وversion control وAPIs وnetworking وsecurity.
sentences.en: From a small program to a real software system — objects, tests, version control, APIs, networking, security.

sentences.ar: من database واحدة لـdata platform pipelines وwarehouses وDAGs وSpark وKafka.
sentences.en: From one database to a data platform — pipelines, warehouses, DAGs, Spark, Kafka.

sentences.ar: من المنصة لبيزنس حقيقي mobile money وتقارير near-real-time وreconciliation وgovernance وdisaster recovery.
sentences.en: From a platform to a real business — mobile money, near-real-time reporting, reconciliation, governance, disaster recovery.

sentences.ar: من الـanalytics للـAI statistics وmodels وneural networks وattention وretrieval وagents.
sentences.en: From analytics to AI — statistics, models, neural networks, attention, retrieval, agents.
And finally, from lessons to evidence.

sentences.ar: في مشروع واحد ماشي في السبعة كلهم.
sentences.en: One project runs through all seven.

sentences.ar: يبدأ folder ويخلص نظام تقدر تدافع عنه في interview.
sentences.en: It starts as a folder and ends as a system you can defend in an interview.

sentences.ar: وكل مثال بيستخدم نفس الأربعتاشر field، عشان المعرفة تتراكم مش تبدأ من أول وجديد كل درس.
sentences.en: Every example uses the same fourteen fields, so knowledge compounds instead of resetting.

sentences.ar: الفلوس دايماً decimal مش float، لأن الـbinary floating point مش قادر يمثّل عشرة قروش بالظبط
sentences.en: Money is a decimal, never a float, because binary floating point cannot represent ten piastres exactly

sentences.ar: وglitch في الحساب في نظام مدفوعات مش glitch، دي فلوس عميل ضاعت.
sentences.en: and a rounding error in a payments platform is not a rounding error, it is a missing customer's money.

sentences.ar: والتقدم هنا مش بعدد الدروس اللي خلصتها.
sentences.en: Progress here is not measured in lessons finished.
It is measured in things you can show.

facts.rule: A number goes on screen with its fact id as `ref`/`data_refs`. `unmatched_numbers` are spoken but have no data-contract fact: their source is the sentence itself (a valid `s:` ref); never replace them with a different figure.

glossary.rule: Explain the term in Egyptian Arabic the first time it appears; then use the original term naturally, in Latin script, inside Arabic sentences.
glossary.register_ar: Natural Egyptian, clear, calm, professional. Use إحنا and خلّينا نشوف and ببساطة where they help. No heavy Modern Standard Arabic. No exaggerated slang. Numbers are spoken naturally in Egyptian but displayed as Western digits.
glossary.register_en: Plain, direct, unhurried. Short sentences. No hype, no "imagine that…", no rhetorical questions that are not real prediction prompts. Say the number, then pause for half a beat before the next sentence — the pause is where the viewer reads the screen.
glossary.never_translate_rule: Explain them in Egyptian Arabic the first time they appear, then use the original term naturally.

concepts.def_en: Structured Query Language: the standard declarative language for querying and changing da…
concepts.failure: Thinking SQL runs in written order; the engine plans execution in its own order.

concepts.def_en: Interfaces through which programs call each other to request data or actions, typically over HTTP with JSON.
concepts.def_ar: الـAPIs واجهات برامج بتكلّم بعض بيها عشان تطلب داتا أو تنفّذ أكشن، غالبًا عبر HTTP وJSON.
concepts.failure: Calling an API without handling errors, timeouts or rate limits.

concepts.def_en: An organized store of data managed by software that lets many users and programs safely read, write and query it.
concepts.def_ar: مخزن منظم للداتا بيديره software، بيسمح لمستخدمين وبرامج كتير يقروا ويكتبوا ويعملوا query بأمان.
concepts.failure: Treating a database as a bigger spreadsheet, ignoring keys, constraints and concurrent writes.

concepts.def_en: Apache Spark: a distributed engine that processes large datasets in parallel across a cluster, keeping data in memory where possible.
concepts.def_ar: Apache Spark: engine موزّع بيعالج داتا كبيرة بالتوازي على cluster، وبيحتفظ بالداتا في الذاكرة لما يقدر.
concepts.failure: Using Spark for small data, where cluster overhead outweighs any speed gain.

concepts.def_en: A distributed, append-only event log: producers write events to topics, consumers read forward, and events are retained for a set window.
concepts.def_ar: log موزّع بيتضاف له بس: الـproducers بيكتبوا events في topics والـconsumers بيقروا لقدام، والـevents بتفضل لفترة retention.
concepts.failure: Treating Kafka as a database with a different name; it is a log with retention.

concepts.def_en: Financial services over a mobile phone, such as wallets, transfers and cash in/out, run b…
concepts.failure: Treating balances as a simple column update; money movement needs atomic, auditable trans…

concepts.def_en: After loading, comparing source and target counts and totals to prove nothing was lost, duplicated or changed; any mismatch is investigated.
concepts.def_ar: بعد التحميل بنطابق المصدر بالهدف (أعداد ومجاميع) نثبت إن مفيش حاجة ضاعت أو اتكررت أو اتغيّرت، وأي فرق بيتحقق فيه.
concepts.failure: Assuming a green job run means every row arrived, without comparing counts and totals.

concepts.def_en: The plan, backups and procedures for restoring systems and data after a major failure, within targets for acceptable data loss (RPO) and downtime (RTO).
concepts.def_ar: الـdisaster recovery خطة وbackups وإجراءات لاسترجاع السيستم والداتا بعد عطل كبير، ضمن أهداف للداتا المسموح تضيع (RPO) والتوقف (RTO).
concepts.failure: Having backups but never testing a restore, so recovery fails when needed.

concepts.def_en: Summaries of data distribution, such as row counts and value histograms, which the optimizer uses to estimate costs and choose plans.
concepts.def_ar: ملخصات عن توزيع الداتا، زي عدد الصفوف وhistogram القيم، والـoptimizer بيستخدمها يقدّر التكلفة ويختار الـplan.
concepts.failure: Adding another index when stale statistics, not missing indexes, caused the bad plan.

concepts.def_en: The Transformer mechanism where each token scores all others by relevance and blends their values by those weights, giving context-aware representations.
concepts.def_ar: آلية في الـTransformer كل token فيها بيقيّم باقي الـtokens حسب أهميتها ليه، وبيخلط الـvalues بتاعتهم بالأوزان دي.
concepts.failure: Believing attention knows word order by itself; position information must be added separately.

concepts.def_en: Finding and returning the most relevant documents or chunks for a query, using keyword, vector or hybrid search, before the model generates an answer.
concepts.def_ar: الـretrieval هو إنك تلاقي وترجّع أنسب documents أو chunks للسؤال، بـkeyword أو vector أو hybrid search، قبل ما الموديل يولّد الإجابة.
concepts.failure: Blaming the LLM for wrong answers when retrieval returned the wrong passages.

concepts.def_en: Base-two representation using only 0 and 1, the form in which computers store all data and instructions.
concepts.def_ar: نظام العدّ بالأساس اتنين، مبيستخدم غير 0 و1، وده الشكل اللي الكمبيوتر بيخزّن بيه أي داتا وأوامر.
concepts.failure: Reading binary digits as decimal, forgetting each place is a power of two.

components.does: One whole word (or a tatweel-joined compound like الـKafka) on screen; never split per letter.
Up to 6 kinetic words on at most 2 lines, each word arriving on its own spoken word anchor.
A technical term chip (Latin in an LTR isolate) with an optional Arabic gloss; 28 px floor if spoken.
A counter that rolls from the previous value to the target over the spoken number (preset count).
An arrow from a label to a target layer (or a named part of it, 'layer.part').
Failure beat: glitch + low thud; flashes stay <= 3/s (WCAG 2.3.1).
Fix beat: the target settles into place with a settle chime.
The shot camera: move + ease + intensity; drift always on; optional impact nudges (<= 4 px) on anchors.
Match cut between a layer of this shot and one of the next.
Lower-third caption for a source, term, speaker or location.
Draw an SVG path (stroke reveal; RTL by default for Arabic layouts).
A request travelling hops (client, lb, service, cache, db, queue, external) with per-hop latency.
A data table (<= 8 columns, <= 12 visible rows); numbers come from a data_ref.
Trunk chapter title card (riser + sting in the SFX map).
